title: The middleware onion
description: Implement use() and handle(): look up the route, wrap middleware, return 404 on a miss.

files.description: Request/Response are given; fill in Router.use and Router.handle, and keep find_route

types.name: Request
types.doc: method, path, params, body. handle writes params after lookup.

functions.doc: Look up, write params, run the onion. A miss returns status=404, body='not found'.

notes: Keep Request/Response field names. 404 does not run middleware. Bind loop variables in closures.
